description: This file defines API functions for task management, including listing, creating, updating, and deleting tasks within a project management platform. It exports functions for frontend components to interact with backend endpoints related to tasks.

methods.name: listTasks({ project_id, assignee_id, status, assignee_text } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of tasks with optional filtering parameters like project_id, assignee_id, status, and a client-side filter for assignee_text.

methods.name: createTask(payload)
methods.description: Creates a new task using the provided payload containing task details.

methods.name: updateTask(taskId, payload)
methods.description: Updates an existing task identified by taskId with the provided payload.

methods.name: deleteTask(taskId)
methods.description: Deletes a task identified by taskId.

ctags.name: listTasks
ctags.pattern: /^export async function listTasks({ project_id, assignee_id, status, assignee_text } = {}) {$/
